web_fixture.title: Ingest errors - Hallowbrook
web_fixture.snippet: HB-5510 is raised once a single request body goes past 128 kilobytes.
web_fixture.content:
# Ingest errors

Hallowbrook, reviewed 2026-02-19.

| code | raised when | what to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HB-5502 | the request carries no content type | set the header and send the body again |
| HB-5510 | a single request body goes past 128 kilobytes | split the payload into smaller requests |
| HB-5533 | the account has no ingest quota left this month | raise the quota or wait for the next month |

The body ceiling is per request: a body of exactly 128 kilobytes is accepted and
the next kilobyte ends on HB-5510. The ceiling does not depend on how many
requests the account sends.

web_fixture.title: Edge buffering - Hallowbrook
web_fixture.snippet: The edge buffers 96 kilobytes of a request body before it starts streaming to the ingest nodes.
web_fixture.content:
# Edge buffering

Hallowbrook.

The edge buffers 96 kilobytes of an incoming body before it starts streaming it
to the ingest nodes. The buffer size is an internal figure and does not change
the size a request is allowed to carry.

turns.prompt: One of our senders keeps ending on Hallowbrook error HB-5510 and the vendor has asked how large its bodies may be. How many kilobytes may one request body carry before that error is raised? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
